text: The purpose of this report is to present a new Executive Compensation policy (Policy 235), developed to align with the City of Toronto’s Guiding Principles for the Development of Senior Executive Compensation Policies, for the Board’s approval.
The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved Policy 235 – Executive Compensation, as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (August 24, 2026) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live.
